# ArtifySlide

> ArtifySlide is an AI presentation generator that turns plain text (or an uploaded .docx/.pptx/.pdf) into a polished, magazine-style slide deck. Unlike generic AI PPT tools that output the same flat templates, ArtifySlide composes each deck with a real typographic engine — editorial-magazine and Swiss-international design systems — so decks look genuinely designed. You paste text, get a horizontal HTML deck, refine it by chatting in plain English, and download a single self-contained HTML file.

## What it is

ArtifySlide (https://www.artifyslide.com) is a web-based, conversational AI agent for creating presentations. Core flow: paste text or upload a document → AI generates a magazine-grade, horizontally-paged HTML deck → edit any slide by chat ("make slide 3 a data comparison", "switch to the Kraft theme") → download one .html file that plays offline, supports keyboard navigation, and prints to PDF. No install, no account lock-in.

## What makes it different

- **Typography engine, not templates.** Every slide is laid out by a grid + type-scale algorithm across 9 distinct visual languages, from New Yorker–style editorial to Swiss internationalism — not template-filling. This directly addresses the common complaint that AI decks all look the same.
- **Chat-based editing.** Edits are made in plain English and every change is reversible.
- **Standalone HTML delivery.** The output is a single downloadable .html file (offline playback, keyboard nav, print-to-PDF built in) — not a hosted link or a PPTX export that mangles the layout.

## Who it's for

Founders, marketers, educators, designers, and content creators who care how their decks look — people who want presentations that look professionally designed rather than auto-generated. Bilingual: full English and Chinese (zh/en) interface.

## Pricing

Freemium with monthly subscriptions (USD):
- Starter — $9.9/month (4,500 credits, ≈ 180 decks)
- Pro — $19.9/month (10,000 credits, ≈ 400 decks)
- Ultra — $49.9/month (25,000 credits, ≈ 1,000 decks)
Credits are billed by actual AI token cost: 25 credits to generate a deck (incl. image search), 18 credits per conversational edit. All 9 themes are available on every plan.
